notes.title: Avaris2 has launched
notes.notes:
[img]http://ent.zoo.jp/images/Ava2_update01.gif[/img]
Check out this battlefield management game from Japanese indie developer Studio GIW. You are the Empress fighting to take back control of the Avaris Empire. Battle by battle as you recover territory, the number of fighters grows to near epic proportions up to 36,000 individual warriors on the battlefield! 25% off for the first week. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421890

notes.title: Steam Achievements coming soon!
notes.notes:
We've been working on adding Steam achievements to the game and we're almost ready to launch.  We know this is something that the community has been asking for and we're looking forward to the new version.  Please stay tuned over the coming days.

近日中に実績対応のアップデートが行われる予定です。
更新され次第NEWSでお知らせ致しますので、今しばらくお待ちください。
どうぞお楽しみに！

notes.title: Dungeon Manager ZV Update! Ver 2.20E
notes.notes:
[img]http://ent.zoo.jp/images/DMZV_update_image02.png[/img]
[b]Dungeon Manager ZV Update:  Japanese now available![/b]
[b]オリジナルの日本語版がプレイ出来るようになりました！[/b]

You can now choose to play in the original Japanese.  In the updated version
there is a language selection dialog box when you start the game.  Please
note that on non-Japanese versions of Windows some Japanese characters may
not display correctly.

【アップデート内容】
・日本語対応
・日本語と英語の言語選択機能追加

notes.title: Dungeon Manager ZV Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://ent.zoo.jp/images/DMZV_update_image01.png[/img]
[b]Updated version of the game includes:[/b]
- In the Option screen, you can now select to not display popup messages
during game play.
- Some of the English text has been edited so it fits better where
displayed.

Thank you to the community for your requests and for pointing out some of
the problems.  We hope this makes for a better game experience.
